source_text: Si digne intelligas exitum et transitum et iter deserti, suscipe legem spiritu Dei vivis scriptam. Tunc tabernaculum aedificare potes.
pass_a_gloss: If worthily you-understand exit and crossing and journey of-desert, receive law with-spirit of-God living written. Then tabernacle to-build you-can.
pass_b_english: If you worthily understand the exodus, the sea-crossing, and the desert road, receive the law [[written not with ink but with the Spirit of the living God >> Bible:2 Corinthians 3:3]]. Then you can build the tabernacle.
